The machine correctly fired nothing: gate rank peaked around 0.66, well below P95, latch memory was flagged active but smoke was 0.20 against the 0.80 required floor, and the blackout (00:00–08:00) covered the entire loading spike regardless. The day was legible but unharvestable — a textbook contraction-regime overnight spike that armed no gate and left no victims.
